parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe two differences between the decay of a nucleus that emits a $β^{-}$ particle and the decay of a nucleus that emits a $β^{+}$ particle.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: In a simple quark model there are three types of quark. State the composition of the proton and of the neutron in terms of these three quarks.
